about: Mod ping-pong round 5, batch 6 (docs/design/mod-pingpong.md#lote-6--iris): Iris, approved by Elias on 27 September with shaders off by default and no shader pack in the pack. Default Options seeds config/iris.properties once (enableShaders=false), so a player who turns shaders on keeps that choice across pack updates.

qol.iris: Loads OptiFine-format shader packs the player adds; none ship, shaders start off, and the Shader Packs button in the video settings turns them on
